meta.name: geo-connector
meta.description: Search, query, and cross-reference NCBI GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) datasets with ENCODE experiments. Use when the user wants to find GEO accessions for ENCODE experiments, search GEO for complementary datasets, download GEO metadata or series matrices, cross-reference ENCODE and GEO data, find supplementary files from GEO, or link GEO series to ENCODE experiments for provenance tracking. Also use when the user mentions GEO, GSE, GSM, GPL, GDS, series matrix, SOFT format, or needs to find expression data in GEO that complements their ENCODE analysis.

copy.tagline: 搜索和查询NCBI GEO与ENCODE数据集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GEO和ENCODE之间交叉查找基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Search and query NCBI GEO and ENCODE datasets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to cross-reference gene expression data between GEO and ENCODE

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索 NCBI GEO 数据库，查找与 ENCODE 实验互补的数据集，下载 GEO 元数据和系列矩阵，并在 ENCODE 实验和 GEO 数据集之间建立交叉引用链接。
howto.when: 当用户提到 GEO、GSE、GSM、GPL、GDS、系列矩阵、SOFT 格式，或需要查找与 ENCODE 分析互补的表达数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下胰腺 RNA-seq 的 GEO 数据集。
say.note: Claude 会搜索 GEO 中相关的系列并返回结果。

say.text: 把这个 ENCODE 实验链接到对应的 GEO 编号。
下载 GSE12345 的系列矩阵文件。
say.note: Claude 会从 GEO FTP 下载该系列的矩阵文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search NCBI GEO database for datasets complementary to ENCODE experiments, download GEO metadata and series matrices, and cross-reference ENCODE experiments with GEO datasets by linking accessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions GEO, GSE, GSM, GPL, GDS, series matrix, SOFT format, or needs to find expression data in GEO that complements their ENCODE analysis.

say_en.text: Find GEO datasets for pancreatic islet RNA-seq.
say_en.note: Claude will search GEO for relevant series and return results.

say_en.text: Link this ENCODE experiment to its GEO accession.
say_en.note: Claude will check the experiment's dbxrefs for GEO IDs and create a link.

say_en.text: Download the series matrix for GSE12345.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the matrix file from GEO FTP.
